steps.title: is_palindrome ignores case and punctuation
steps.description:
Create is_palindrome(text) in texttools/palin.py.
1. cleaned = ""
2. For each ch in text.lower():
   - if ch.isalnum(): cleaned = cleaned + ch
3. return cleaned == cleaned[::-1]

args: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama

steps.title: caesar_shift moves letters along the alphabet
steps.description:
Create caesar_shift(text, shift) in texttools/caesar.py. Letters wrap around the alphabet; everything else stays as it is.
1. result = ""
2. For each ch in text:
   - if ch.islower(): result = result + chr((ord(ch) - ord("a") + shift) % 26 + ord("a"))
   - elif ch.isupper(): result = result + chr((ord(ch) - ord("A") + shift) % 26 + ord("A"))
   - else: result = result + ch
3. return result

steps.title: word_counts counts how often each word appears
steps.description:
Create word_counts(text) in texttools/counts.py. Words are lowercase and split on spaces. Return a dict that maps each word to how many times it appears, with the words in the order they first appear.
1. counts = {}
2. For each word in text.lower().split():
   - counts[word] = counts.get(word, 0) + 1
3. return counts

steps.title: most_common_word finds the word used most
steps.description:
Create most_common_word(text) in texttools/common.py. Use word_counts from texttools/counts.py (already written, shown below). If two words are used equally often, the one that appears first wins.
1. If text.split() is empty, raise ValueError.
2. counts = word_counts(text)
3. best = None
4. For each word in counts:
   - if best is None or counts[word] > counts[best]:
     - best = word
5. return best

steps.title: truncate shortens long text with three dots
steps.description:
Create truncate(text, limit) in texttools/trunc.py.
1. If limit is less than 3, raise ValueError.
2. If len(text) <= limit, return text.
3. return text[:limit - 3] + "..."
